newsitem.title: ALBANIA: EU provides aid for Albania road network.
newsitem.headline: EU provides aid for Albania road network.

text.p: The European Union is to provide Albania with nearly 50 million Ecus ($61.77 million) in aid to help the impoverished country improve its road network, a government official said on Thursday.
Brussels had approved two separate funds for projects under the EU's PHARE programme, Public Affairs Ministry official Roland Olli told Reuters.
The PHARE programme provides technical aid to ex-communist states in central and Eastern Europe.
Some 29 million Ecus would go to building a motorway between the capital Tirana and the Adriatic coastal town of Durres, scheduled to be completed by 1999, Olli said.
The road would be the first motorway linking two towns in Albania, which had banned cars as a symbol of capitalist decadence during 45 years of hardline communist rule.
The rest of the aid would finance roads in northern Albania and another route connecting the east and west of the country, Olli added. ($1=.8095 Ecu)
